item.title: Roadmap
item.description:
The following is the high-level roadmap for the Openpresso project.

  • Phase 1: Libopenpresso (Completed)

    Core hardware abstraction library

  • Phase 2: Openpressod (Completed)

    Machine control daemon

  • Phase 3: Openpresso-ctl (Completed)

    Daemon control CLI tool

item.title: Subprojects
item.description:
